blocks.content:
## Wave 1 — complete and verified

The verifier approved all four fixes with high confidence, and all four task notes are now marked `complete`:

| Issue | Fix | Verified |
|---|---|---|
| [#2150](https://github.com/intent-hq/monorepo/issues/2150) | [monorepo#2220](https://github.com/intent-hq/monorepo/pull/2220) | §5.7 now states the 500 ms vs 5 s cadence asymmetry and the bounded fast-cadence coverage |
| [#2002](https://github.com/intent-hq/monorepo/issues/2002) | [cloudlands-fe#1124](https://github.com/intent-hq/cloudlands-fe/pull/1124) | No `secrets.*` in any `run:` body; `SM_*` env gated on sign inputs in both workflows |
| [#2091](https://github.com/intent-hq/monorepo/issues/2091) | [cloudlands-fe#1126](https://github.com/intent-hq/cloudlands-fe/pull/1126) | `test-ct` job wired into CI Gate and green on its own PR; follow-up [#2224](https://github.com/intent-hq/monorepo/issues/2224) filed |
| [#2060](https://github.com/intent-hq/monorepo/issues/2060) | [intentd#1179](https://github.com/intent-hq/intentd/pull/1179) + [monorepo#2226](https://github.com/intent-hq/monorepo/pull/2226) | `watchStillArmed` set on all wake paths, tested in both polarities, documented in PROTOCOL.md |

## Wave 2 — ready

I've created the four Wave 2 tasks in the [Spec](intent://local/note/spec): #2161 (restore virtualization) and #2040 (batch delegate rendering) in cloudlands-fe, #2118 (reaper TOCTOU) and #2050 (persist-before-publish) in intentd — the two intentd fixes carry a conflict hint so they serialize rather than collide in `agent_manager.rs`/session paths.

One item needs a decision: the verifier found **6 issues still untyped** that were outside the original scan — #433 and #2053 (assigned, so excluded by the no-assignee filter) plus #2221, #2224, #2227, #2228 (created during Wave 1, including our own follow-up #2224).

I've asked two questions above: whether to delegate Wave 2 now, and what to do about the newly untyped issues.
